summary.intent: Implement writable share functionality with permission controls, including backend API changes and a UI toggle for share permissions.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (API backend) was completed with share entity permission enum, encryptedIpnsKey column, PATCH endpoint, and IPNS publish authorization. Wave 2 (UI toggle) was spawned but its completion is not confirmed in the transcript.

repo: Shares have a permission enum (read/write) and an encryptedIpnsKey column for write shares
IPNS publish flow checks share permission to authorize write-share recipients
Work is organized into numbered plans (e.g., 27-01, 27-02) with wave-based execution ordering
Each plan produces a SUMMARY.md and associated commits, verified via spot-check after wave completion
workflow: Wave-based agent execution: Wave 1 completes and is verified before Wave 2 is spawned
Cross-plan dependency (key-links) are explicitly checked before spawning dependent agents
Idempotent migrations are expected as part of backend schema changes
